Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-cyokotto-wakoucha/

Explore the wetlands of Haraichiba area to search for wildlife, and make handmade Japanese black tea using Hanno tea as a collaborative activity.

【Participation fee】
¥2,500 per person, ¥5,000 per family (includes guide fee, instructor fee, insurance)

【Capacity】
12 people

【Guide】
Kojima Tsubasa (Hanno City Eco-Tourism Citizen Guides Association – Wildlife Division)

【What to bring】
• Drinking water, towel, work gloves (like cotton gloves)
• Insect repellent, rain gear
• Child life jacket if you have one (rentals available)
• Aquatic net or collection case if you have one (rentals available)
• Clothes suitable for getting wet (avoid exposing too much skin)
• Non-slip shoes suitable for getting wet that work in water up to knee depth (no rubber boots or sandals)
• Hat
location: 集合 原市場福祉センター玄関前（国際興業バス「原市場」下車徒歩2分）
summary: Easy Eco-Tour: Wildlife Spotting at Haraichiba & Handmade Japanese Black Tea
